name: Pellucid Prism Fashion Sneaker
description: A low-profile fashion sneaker with a translucent upper panel that reveals a structural mesh layer beneath, dyed in shifting iridescent tones. The midsole is thick and clean white. Pellucid makes statement pieces for people who want to be seen — these read as art-adjacent without being unwearable. Extremely popular at social events and gallery openings.
functionality: The iridescent mesh layer has passive photoluminescence — it holds ambient light and releases it slowly in dim environments.
what_it_says: You're plugged into what's current. Fashion-forward, social, comfortable spending on aesthetics.
story_hooks: The photoluminescent mesh has been used to pass encoded messages in nightclub settings — a specific dye pattern, invisible in daylight.
A limited run in a single colorway sold out in eleven minutes and now trades for triple retail on secondary markets.
